cases.name: selector_label_known_account

agent_provision.note: AgentSStation is derived here, not asserted: the accepted provision's signed payload.agent_id plus its controller account/Station, reconciled with the accepted Agent PCR genesis actor account. No consumer may substitute its own Station for this.

selector_claim.note: The agent_selector_claim typed current value written by the accepted ak.agent.provision. The selector (controller_subject_id, agent_slug) stays principal-scoped; the bound target is one complete AccountId derived from that provision, never rebuilt from the bare principal.

selector_claim_disclosure.note: The current selector value may verify a label only after a separate authorized source supplied the exact full Agent AccountId; it is not a lookup response.

assertions: the persisted mention subject_account_id is copied verbatim from the already-authorized exact full Agent AccountId; a selector claim can only verify a label and can never select the target
the agent Station is derived from the accepted provision reconciled with the Agent PCR genesis actor account, not from a fixture constant
the selector namespace stays principal-scoped while the bound target is account-scoped; neither is derived from the other
controller and slug snapshots are audit metadata only; the unsupported free-text composite token remains plain text without mention metadata or directed notification
slug changes do not rewrite historical mention targets
ambiguous or unavailable selector claims do not verify a label or retarget a known-account mention, and two current claims pointing at the same principal on two Stations are never deduplicated

a member account with the same principal on another Station does not match the mention: comparison covers principal_id and station_id, so it produces no mention notification and no authorization or MemberIdentity join hit
a visible selector value whose subject_account_id differs from the known picker target is rejected for label verification; no Directory selector lookup operation exists
expected_actor_id is a consistency assertion: a service Actor never matches and it cannot select a winner out of an ambiguous label
a local authorized source may supply the known full AccountId but cannot establish cross-Station selector uniqueness; this ruling adds no read, notification or participation right to a non-member
an Agent whose provision has not completed cannot receive a verified label, and a server must not expose private provision material to fill a fabricated lookup response

Explicit candidate selection binds a visible draft token range to the exact known AccountId; unselected strings, edited/deleted tokens and private holder notes never create or retarget a mention. Routing follows sidecar section 8.1 for each current draft and send attempt: no Agent target uses the original Strand, current private owned Agent targets use Sidecar, public targets use the original Strand. Prior Sidecar session, addressed targets, accepted requests or merged history never supply a current target. No private-failure fallback or automatic mixed-target split.

cases.name: ceiling_tighten
assertions: Circle and Strand participation ceilings may only drop bits from their parent
a child that enables act_on_behalf below a disabled parent bit is rejected
a Strand that re-enables a Circle-disabled third-party mention bit is rejected

cases.name: effective_intersection
assertions: effective participation is the bitwise meet of the current governance/deployment ceiling and controller selection
the five controller selection bits are independent and are not derived from requested scope
participation is an additional action gate and never materializes a capability grant
act-on-behalf is denied when the current ceiling disables it
tightening the ceiling immediately disables the corresponding action gate
unknown or stale ceiling source fails closed to no effective participation

cases.name: selection_cas
assertions: Account Authority stores the full controller selection without converting it into authority
target action enforcement intersects the stored selection with current governance
a capped selection bit grants no action and creates no capability grant

cases.name: session_overlay
assertions: session scope_details.participation entries are isomorphic to agent_participation_entry
the overlay is a behavior contract and not an authorization boundary
missing backing capability grant still fails the runtime operation

cases.name: third_party_mention_gate
assertions: when accept_third_party_mention is false, non-controller mentions fan out to no agent delivery artifacts
the controller's own mention still delivers
enabling third-party mention later is non-retroactive
subsequent third-party mentions deliver only after the effective bit is true

cases.name: ceiling_unresolved_fail_closed
assertions: a stale, unavailable or unverifiable required policy layer fails the action-time gate closed
the unresolved policy is treated as all false and the controller selection stays stored unchanged

cases.name: reply_not_permitted_by_selection
assertions: an Agent may author ak.message.create only where the current controller selection and the current target policy both enable reply_message
effective participation is the bitwise meet of the current governance/deployment ceiling and controller selection
participation is an additional action gate and never materializes a capability grant
